text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands - leadership asked for a clearer timeline + deps for API streaming, the Console UX rework, and Optimize feature rollouts. Putting questions and answers here. :wave:
Isaac: Quick Q - is the API streaming GA date still early-Q3? need something firm for customer comms.
Maya: Target is early Q3, but final GA depends on canary metrics. Plan: 2-week canary starting 2026-05-12, then gradual ramp if metrics hold.
Priya: What specific canary metrics will determine go/no-go?
Maya: Must-haves for canary: p95 latency <= 120ms on short-chat shapes, error rate < 0.1%, and cost delta <= +8%. If any fail we pause.
Tom: I’ll own latency probes and dashboard. Will post probe configs and expected baselines by EOD.
Leila: SRE note - will run canary across us-west/us-east; if cross-region p95 variance > 20% we automatically pause.
Avery: Console rework rollout plan: internal beta (4 weeks), limited external beta (8 weeks), public GA (12 weeks). Legacy console stays available for ~6 months for migration.
Isaac: For Optimize: will recommendations be auto-applied or opt-in?
Maya: Optimize is opt-in at launch. We’ll show a "suggested profile" with projected cost delta + quality score. Auto-apply only for enterprise under explicit rollout policies.
Priya: Migration path for existing projects that rely on current defaults?
Tom: Building a migration shim that maps legacy defaults -> suggested profiles, plus a dry-run mode to preview cost/quality changes. ETA: ~6 weeks.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-probes:v2 -> canary pool (2026-04-20T15:02:00Z) :rocket:
Leila: Will also add a runbook with rollback thresholds and a playbook for partial mitigations.
Maya: Action items summary: Tom post probe repo + configs, Leila publish canary runbook, Avery draft customer comms and migration FAQ. I’ll collate a single timeline doc in #docs by EOD and schedule a 30m follow-up next week. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
